historical_record.description: The Pioneer Log Cabin was built in 1911.
The Recreation and Park Commission ratified a $44,656 contract with Page, Anderson and Turnbull, Inc. for design services for the second phase of work on the Pioneer Log Cabin.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded Henry Chapot Construction a $296,418 contract to restore the Pioneer Log Cabin.
The Recreation and Park Commission approved a conceptual plan for new water mains, utility lines, electrical service and disabled access around the Pioneer Log Cabin.
